name: Zheng He's third voyage
summary: On the third voyage the fleet fights its way out of Ceylon: the Sinhala king Alakeshvara is captured and taken to Nanjing. The trilingual stone at Galle, in Chinese, Tamil and Persian, dates from this voyage.

stops.note: A walled depot and warehouses are built at Malacca.
Leaves a stone in Chinese, Tamil and Persian giving offerings to the Buddha, to a Hindu god and to Allah.
Ambushed on the way home, the fleet storms the capital and captures King Alakeshvara.
The captive king is brought before the emperor, then sent home.
